symptoms: leaf: Small gray spots on lower leaf surfaces that turn tan or reddish-brown Lesions scattered within yellow halos Pustules (blisters) develop in lesions releasing tan spores Early symptoms difficult to distinguish from other leaf diseases pod_stem: Lesions and pustules may appear on pods and stems timing: Most common after flowering, during reproductive stages
description: Soybean rust is a foliar disease of soybean caused by the fungus Phakopsora pachyrhizi. It can cause severe yield losses under favorable conditions.
management: cultural_control: Scout lower canopy weekly, especially during wet weather Cultural practices have limited effect chemical_control: Use foliar fungicides applied early or immediately after infection genetic_control: Soybean varieties resistant to rust are under development
